title: Ion channels versus ion pumps: the principal difference, in principle
funder: NIH grants HL36783, HL49907 and DK51767.
result: Review. Each Na,K-ATPase pump exports 3 Na+ and imports 2 K+ for each ATP hydrolysed and can repeat this cycle up to a hundred times a second; the net charge movement generates a current of about 20 attoamperes per pump.
